newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Oct 9.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Oct 9.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices were little changed on Wednesday despite firmer cargo prices. They said buyers withdrew bids after cargo prices rose. Sellers dropped their offers leaving prices little moved from Tuesday. A 2,000-tonne parcel of 380-cst was heard traded at $123 per tonne. Another trader said some ships were bunkering in South Korea as prices were more competitive.--Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082).
